tables.title: 2. Replication: annual CEO B
tables.subtitle: Original window2006–2011, extended window2006–2023 and additional window2013–2023; columns(8)–(10); Delta/Vega excluded
notes: All own models use annual CEO B and omit Delta/Vega only from the corresponding original setting. Vega and the relevant inside-debt proxy remain in models(8)–(10). The published reference table is unchanged.

Own estimates are Stata19.5 Logit coefficients; parentheses are firm-gvkey cluster standard errors (CR0*G/(G-1)). Stars denote1%,5%,10%. All25 OIM and cluster fits converged without omitted core variables.

Industry SIC2 and fiscal-year dummies plus intercept are included. No PCEO filter, firm FE or CEO FE. Existing22 models retain their previous estimation samples. The added2013–2023 replication uses the frozen full annual-B panel restricted to fiscal years2013–2023, without requiring synthetic proxy of CEO risk preference coverage.

Model(9) uses positive relative leverage and therefore a smaller sample. Table3 excludes both actual R&D/assets and the R&D missing dummy; Table4 retains both. The fourth setting keeps cash compensation, equity wealth and other controls but no inside-debt proxy or Vega.
Original-paper parentheses are printed signed sqrt(Wald), not standard errors. The original Table4 clustering is unspecified. Published coefficients and stars are preserved as printed.

Replication controls retain their frozen input units, explicitly labeled in each row. Profitability is labeled$thousand in the paper but uses$million in our data; asset growth is printed(%) in the paper but is a decimal ratio here. Return volatility is in pp in our data.

The author final sample and operational full-disclosure rules remain unrecovered. These own models deliberately omit Delta/Vega and are modified specifications, not exact reproductions of the original Table4.
